SELECT rc.loan_id, rc.as_of_date
FROM risk_classification rc
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE cg.grade_name_zh = '次级'
ORDER BY rc.loan_id ASC;

SELECT loan_id, disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown
WHERE status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'

SELECT payment_id, business_date, amount
FROM payment_event
WHERE payment_type = 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL'
  AND amount > 5000000
ORDER BY amount DESC;

SELECT p.party_id, pp.annual_income
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND pp.annual_income > 1000000
ORDER BY pp.annual_income DESC;

SELECT card_id, issued_on, expires_on
FROM payment_card
WHERE card_type = 'CREDIT'
ORDER BY issued_on ASC;

SELECT p.party_id, p.display_name, op.operating_status
FROM party p
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
  AND op.registered_region = (
      SELECT region_code 
      FROM organization_unit 
      WHERE unit_name = '上海分行' 
      LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY p.party_id ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id AS 机构单元编号,
    ou.unit_name AS 机构单元名称,
    COUNT(a.account_id) AS 账户数
FROM organization_unit ou
LEFT JOIN account a ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 账户数 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.sector_name_zh AS 行业中文名称,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS 合同金额合计
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector i ON op.industry_code = i.sector_code
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
GROUP BY i.sector_name_zh
ORDER BY 合同金额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.fair_value), 2) AS total_holding_value
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
ORDER BY total_holding_value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id AS 机构单元编号,
    ou.unit_name AS 机构单元名称,
    COUNT(pr.relation_id) AS 关联方关系数量
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN party p ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 关联方关系数量 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(cs.risk_weighted_assets, 2) AS risk_weighted_assets
FROM capital_snapshot cs
JOIN institution i ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY cs.net_capital DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ab.ledger_balance), 2) AS total_deposit_balance
FROM account a
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN account_balance_snapshot ab ON a.account_id = ab.account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND ab.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_deposit_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    ROUND(AVG(ds.principal_overdue_days), 2) AS 平均逾期天数
FROM delinquency_snapshot ds
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING AVG(ds.principal_overdue_days) > 90
ORDER BY AVG(ds.principal_overdue_days) DESC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id AS 集团编号,
    eg.group_name AS 集团名称,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS 敞口金额,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS 敞口占资本净额比重
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
ORDER BY 敞口占资本净额比重 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.sector_name_zh AS 行业名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 贷款笔数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cg.is_nonperforming = 1 THEN ld.loan_id END) AS 不良笔数,
    ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cg.is_nonperforming = 1 THEN ld.loan_id END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id), 6) AS 不良笔数占比
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector i ON op.industry_code = i.sector_code
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE cg.grade_code IN ('SUBSTANDARD', 'DOUBTFUL', 'LOSS')
GROUP BY i.sector_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) >= 20
ORDER BY 不良笔数占比 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS 合同金额合计
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 合同金额合计 DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT 
    risk_level,
    COUNT(*) AS product_count,
    ROUND(AVG(management_fee_rate), 4) AS avg_management_fee_rate
FROM wealth_product
GROUP BY risk_level
ORDER BY risk_level ASC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id AS 担保人编号,
    p.display_name AS 担保人名称,
    ROUND(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 在保余额合计
FROM guarantor_commitment g
JOIN party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE g.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY g.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) > 500000000
ORDER BY 在保余额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS 合同金额合计
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN party p ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(ca.contract_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY SUM(ca.contract_amount) DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(d.record_id) AS record_count,
    ROUND(SUM(d.observed_value), 2) AS total_observed_value
FROM data_security_event_v3 d
JOIN institution i ON d.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE d.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_observed_value DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_count
FROM regulatory_submission_event_v3 rse
JOIN institution i ON rse.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE (rse.completion_date IS NULL OR rse.completion_date > rse.deadline_date)
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY overdue_count DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 6) AS capital_adequacy_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY capital_adequacy_ratio ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ds.principal_overdue_days AS 逾期天数,
    cg.grade_name_zh AS 分类名称,
    rc.as_of_date AS 分类日期
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days > 90
  AND rc.grade_code IN ('NORMAL', 'SPECIAL_MENTION')
  AND rc.as_of_date = (
      SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
      FROM risk_classification rc2 
      WHERE rc2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
  )
ORDER BY ds.principal_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS insufficient_provision_loan_balance
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = ps.as_of_date
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) > 100000000
ORDER BY insufficient_provision_loan_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    pi.instruction_id AS 支付指令编号,
    pi.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    p.display_name AS 收款方名称,
    ind.sector_name_zh AS 行业中文名称,
    pi.instruction_amount AS 指令金额
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN party p ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector ind ON op.industry_code = ind.sector_code
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 违规流入金额,
    ROUND(SUM(pi.instruction_amount), 2) AS 指令金额合计,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pi.instruction_amount), 0), 6) AS 占比
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN party p ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
LEFT JOIN industry_sector ind ON op.industry_code = ind.sector_code
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 占比 DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_id AS 产品编号,
    wp.product_name AS 产品名称,
    phs.asset_id AS 底层资产编号,
    ma.maturity_on AS 资产到期日,
    wp.actual_termination_on AS 产品终止日
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE wp.actual_termination_on IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.maturity_on > wp.actual_termination_on
ORDER BY ma.maturity_on DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 主体编号,
    p.display_name AS 名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.security_id) AS 担保笔数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 借款协议笔数
FROM party p
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE gc.security_id IS NOT NULL AND ca.agreement_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 担保笔数 DESC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id AS 交易编号,
    pe.business_date AS 业务日期,
    ptc.name_zh AS 交易类型中文名称,
    pe.amount AS 金额,
    ou.unit_name AS 经办机构单元名称
FROM payment_event pe
LEFT JOIN payment_type_catalog ptc ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type
LEFT JOIN organization_unit ou ON pe.origin_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.amount > 5000000
  AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 协议编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    ind_borrower.sector_name_zh AS 借款人注册行业名称,
    ind_target.sector_name_zh AS 协议投向行业名称,
    ca.contract_amount AS 合同金额
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
LEFT JOIN industry_sector ind_borrower ON op.industry_code = ind_borrower.sector_code
LEFT JOIN industry_sector ind_target ON ca.target_industry_code = ind_target.sector_code
WHERE ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND op.industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND ca.target_industry_code != op.industry_code
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id AS 交易编号,
    pe.business_date AS 业务日期,
    pe.amount AS 金额,
    ah_from.party_id AS 付款方客户编号,
    ah_to.party_id AS 收款方客户编号
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account_holder ah_from ON pe.from_account_id = ah_from.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah_to ON pe.to_account_id = ah_to.account_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.source_party_id = ah_from.party_id 
    AND pr.target_party_id = ah_to.party_id
WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 协议编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 借据笔数
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 3
ORDER BY COUNT(ld.loan_id) DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(p.payment_id) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM payment_event p
JOIN account a ON p.from_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN institution i ON ou.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE p.is_cash = 1
  AND p.amount > 5000000
  AND p.status = 'SETTLED'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(p.payment_id) >= 50
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    sm.staff_id AS 员工工号,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 笔数
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account a ON pe.to_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON a.account_id = ah.account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector ind ON op.industry_code = ind.sector_code
JOIN staff_assignment sa ON sm.staff_id = sa.staff_id
JOIN staff_member sm ON sa.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
GROUP BY sm.staff_id
ORDER BY 笔数 DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    cdd.record_id,
    i.institution_name,
    cdd.event_date,
    cdd.deadline_date,
    CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(cdd.deadline_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_diff
FROM customer_due_diligence_event_v3 cdd
JOIN institution i ON cdd.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE cdd.completion_date IS NULL
  AND cdd.deadline_date IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY days_diff DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
    cl.collateral_id AS 抵押物编号,
    cl.status AS 抵押物状态,
    sa.status AS 担保合同状态
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
WHERE cl.status = 'RELEASED'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY sa.security_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ca.agreement_id AS 协议编号,
    sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
    sa.secured_amount AS 担保债权金额
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY sa.secured_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS principal_balance,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.institution_id ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC) AS balance_rank
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.sector_name_zh AS 行业中文名称,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS 本金余额,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY op.industry_code ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC) AS 排名
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector i ON op.industry_code = i.sector_code
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND op.industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    SELECT COUNT(*) 
    FROM (
        SELECT ld2.loan_id, lbs2.principal_balance
        FROM loan_drawdown ld2
        JOIN credit_agreement ca2 ON ld2.agreement_id = ca2.agreement_id
        JOIN organization_profile op2 ON ca2.borrower_party_id = op2.party_id
        JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 ON ld2.loan_id = lbs2.loan_id
        WHERE lbs2.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
          AND op2.industry_code = op.industry_code
    ) t
    WHERE t.principal_balance > lbs.principal_balance
  ) < 3
ORDER BY i.sector_name_zh ASC, 排名 ASC;

SELECT 
    business_date,
    COUNT(*) AS daily_count,
    COUNT(*) - LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY business_date) AS count_change
FROM payment_event
GROUP BY business_date
ORDER BY business_date ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    lbs.principal_balance AS 本金余额,
    ROUND(avg_balance.avg_principal, 2) AS 本机构平均余额,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance - avg_balance.avg_principal, 2) AS 超出平均值的金额
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        AVG(lbs2.principal_balance) AS avg_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld2
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld2.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 ON ld2.loan_id = lbs2.loan_id
    WHERE lbs2.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
) avg_balance ON ca.institution_id = avg_balance.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > avg_balance.avg_principal
ORDER BY (lbs.principal_balance - avg_balance.avg_principal) DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM security_agreement sa
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
WHERE cl.collateral_link_id IS NULL
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY sa.secured_amount DESC;

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN d.principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN '未逾期'
    WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1-30天'
    WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN '31-90天'
    WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN '91-180天'
    WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN '181-360天'
    ELSE '360天以上'
  END AS overdue_interval,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM delinquency_snapshot d
WHERE d.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY overdue_interval
ORDER BY MIN(
  CASE 
    WHEN d.principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN 0
    WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 1
    WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN 31
    WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN 91
    WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN 181
    ELSE 361
  END
);

SELECT 
    collateral_id,
    valued_on,
    COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count
FROM collateral_valuation
GROUP BY collateral_id, valued_on
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY collateral_id ASC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 贷款笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 本金余额合计,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id), 2) AS 平均单笔金额
FROM party p
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
  AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 平均单笔金额 DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    ou.unit_name AS 机构单元名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS 员工人数,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 经办笔数
FROM organization_unit ou
LEFT JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
LEFT JOIN service_operator so ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
LEFT JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 经办笔数 DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    p.customer_segment AS 客户分层,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id) AS 客户数量,
    ROUND(AVG(pp.annual_income), 2) AS 平均年收入,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pp.annual_income > 1000000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id), 6) AS 高收入客户占比
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN party_type_catalog ptc ON p.party_type = ptc.party_type
WHERE ptc.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pr.relation_id IS NOT NULL THEN pe.amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS related_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pr.relation_id IS NOT NULL THEN pe.amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pe.amount), 0), 6) AS related_ratio
FROM payment_event pe
LEFT JOIN account from_acc ON pe.from_account_id = from_acc.account_id
LEFT JOIN account to_acc ON pe.to_account_id = to_acc.account_id
LEFT JOIN institution i ON COALESCE(from_acc.institution_id, to_acc.institution_id) = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN account_holder from_holder ON from_acc.account_id = from_holder.account_id AND from_holder.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
LEFT JOIN account_holder to_holder ON to_acc.account_id = to_holder.account_id AND to_holder.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
LEFT JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.source_party_id = from_holder.party_id 
    AND pr.target_party_id = to_holder.party_id
    AND pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY related_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS 持有贷记卡数量,
    COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) AS 定期存款账户数量
FROM party p
JOIN payment_card pc ON p.party_id = pc.holder_party_id
JOIN card_type_catalog ctc ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
JOIN account_holder ah ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND ctc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) > 0
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(AVG(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(ld.disbursed_on)), 2) AS avg_loan_age_days
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY avg_loan_age_days DESC

WITH ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        loan_id,
        principal_balance,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY principal_balance DESC) AS quartile_group
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT 
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    quartile_group
FROM ranked_loans
ORDER BY 
    quartile_group ASC,
    principal_balance DESC,
    loan_id ASC
LIMIT 40;

WITH loan_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        op.industry_code,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY op.industry_code
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        lb.industry_code,
        lb.total_balance,
        SUM(lb.total_balance) OVER (ORDER BY lb.total_balance DESC) AS running_total,
        SUM(lb.total_balance) OVER () AS grand_total
    FROM loan_balances lb
)
SELECT 
    isec.sector_name_zh AS 行业名称,
    ROUND(r.total_balance, 2) AS 余额合计,
    ROUND(r.running_total * 1.0 / r.grand_total, 6) AS 累计占比
FROM ranked r
JOIN industry_sector isec ON r.industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE r.running_total * 1.0 / r.grand_total <= 0.8
ORDER BY 累计占比 ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 未结清借据笔数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 2
ORDER BY COUNT(ld.loan_id) DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    ca.collateral_id,
    cv.valuation_amount AS latest_valuation_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
WHERE cv.valuation_amount > 2 * sa.secured_amount
  AND cv.valued_on = (
      SELECT MAX(cv2.valued_on)
      FROM collateral_valuation cv2
      WHERE cv2.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
  )
ORDER BY (cv.valuation_amount - sa.secured_amount) DESC;

SELECT p.party_id AS 客户编号,
       p.display_name AS 客户名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) AS 开户机构家数
FROM party p
JOIN account_holder ah ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) > 1
ORDER BY 开户机构家数 DESC;

SELECT from_account_id AS account_id, business_date AS transaction_date, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM payment_event
GROUP BY from_account_id, business_date
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id) AS member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_balance
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
LEFT JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
WHERE egm.exposure_member_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    gc.guarantor_party_id AS 担保人编号,
    p.display_name AS 担保人名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.security_id) AS 担保合同数量,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 担保金额合计
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT gc.security_id) > 1 AND SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY 担保金额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 借据笔数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 借据笔数 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lbs.loan_id) AS 借据笔数
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.overdue_since IS NOT NULL
  AND julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(lbs.overdue_since) >= 90
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 借据笔数 DESC;

SELECT 
    pi.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款方名称,
    pi.instruction_amount AS 指令金额,
    payee.display_name AS 收款方名称
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN party payee ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = payee.party_id
WHERE pi.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT ca.agreement_id, p.display_name, ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN party_type_catalog ptc ON p.party_type = ptc.party_type
WHERE p.status = 'FROZEN'
  AND ptc.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    lpc.product_name_zh AS 产品中文名称,
    ca.target_industry_code AS 投向行业,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 放款金额
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_product_catalog lpc ON ca.product_family = lpc.product_family
JOIN industry_sector isec ON ca.target_industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE lpc.is_working_capital = 1
  AND isec.risk_category = 'EXIT'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    ROUND(avg_bal.avg_balance, 2) AS avg_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance - avg_bal.avg_balance, 2) AS diff
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN (
    SELECT ca.institution_id, AVG(lbs2.principal_balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld2
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld2.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 ON ld2.loan_id = lbs2.loan_id
    WHERE lbs2.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
) avg_bal ON ca.institution_id = avg_bal.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > 2 * avg_bal.avg_balance
ORDER BY diff DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pr.relation_id IS NULL THEN ca.contract_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 非关联金额,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS 全部金额,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pr.relation_id IS NULL THEN ca.contract_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 0), 6) AS 占比
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN party_relation pr ON ca.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
    AND pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
    AND pr.effective_to IS NULL
GROUP BY ca.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 占比 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 余额合计,
    cs.net_capital AS 资本净额,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS 占比
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, p.party_id, cs.net_capital
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital > 0.10
ORDER BY 占比 DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    ROUND(ca.annual_interest_rate, 4) AS 执行年利率,
    ROUND(industry_avg.avg_rate, 4) AS 所属目标行业平均利率,
    ROUND((ca.annual_interest_rate - industry_avg.avg_rate) / industry_avg.avg_rate * 100, 2) AS 较行业平均上浮百分比
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        target_industry_code,
        AVG(annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement
    WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY target_industry_code
) industry_avg ON ca.target_industry_code = industry_avg.target_industry_code
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND ca.annual_interest_rate > industry_avg.avg_rate * 1.1
ORDER BY 较行业平均上浮百分比 DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.borrower_party_id) AS over_limit_customer_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
  AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) > 0.1 * MAX(cs.net_capital)
ORDER BY over_limit_customer_count DESC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id AS 集团编号,
    eg.group_name AS 集团名称,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS 余额合计,
    cs.net_capital AS 资本净额,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS 占比
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE eg.institution_id = ca.institution_id
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) > 0.1
ORDER BY 占比 DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ca.maturity_on AS 合同到期日,
    ld.loan_id AS 未结清借据编号,
    ld.status AS 借据状态,
    ca.contract_amount AS 合同金额
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'MATURED'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursement_account_id AS 发放账户编号,
    ld.disbursed_on AS 放款日期,
    pe.payment_id AS 转账流水号,
    pe.business_date AS 转账日期,
    pe.amount AS 转账金额,
    CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) AS 放款至转出的间隔天数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.from_account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE pe.payment_type = 'TRANSFER'
  AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND pe.business_date >= ld.disbursed_on
  AND CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) <= 7
ORDER BY 放款至转出的间隔天数 ASC, pe.amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_name,
        p.display_name AS customer_name,
        ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.institution_id ORDER BY SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital DESC) AS rn
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    JOIN party_type_catalog ptc ON p.party_type = ptc.party_type
    JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    WHERE ptc.name_zh = '对公客户'
      AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, p.party_id, p.display_name, cs.net_capital
)
SELECT institution_name, customer_name, ratio
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    lbs.principal_balance AS 本金余额,
    CASE 
        WHEN lbs.principal_balance >= q3 THEN 'Q4'
        WHEN lbs.principal_balance >= q2 THEN 'Q3'
        WHEN lbs.principal_balance >= q1 THEN 'Q2'
        ELSE 'Q1'
    END AS 档位
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN quartile = 1 THEN principal_balance END) AS q1,
        MAX(CASE WHEN quartile = 2 THEN principal_balance END) AS q2,
        MAX(CASE WHEN quartile = 3 THEN principal_balance END) AS q3
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            ca.institution_id,
            lbs.principal_balance,
            NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.institution_id ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC) AS quartile
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
        JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
        JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
        WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    )
    GROUP BY institution_id
) quartiles ON ca.institution_id = quartiles.institution_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY 档位 ASC, 本金余额 DESC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    lbs.principal_balance AS 本金余额,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance * 100.0 / SUM(lbs.principal_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY i.institution_id), 2) AS 占比
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC, 占比 DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 累计放款金额,
    ld.status AS 借据状态,
    COALESCE(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 0) AS 逾期本金合计,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ds.delinquency_id) AS 逾期期次数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
LEFT JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ds.principal_overdue_days > 0
GROUP BY ld.loan_id, ld.disbursed_amount, ld.status
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ds.delinquency_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 逾期期次数 DESC, 逾期本金合计 DESC, 借据编号 ASC;

SELECT 
    loan_account_id AS 放款账户编号,
    disbursed_on AS 放款日期,
    COUNT(*) AS 该日放款借据笔数
FROM loan_drawdown
GROUP BY loan_account_id, disbursed_on
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY 该日放款借据笔数 DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT DISTINCT ah.party_id
FROM account_holder ah
JOIN account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ah.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY ah.party_id ASC;

SELECT p.party_id
FROM party p
WHERE p.party_type = 'STAFF'
  AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM account_holder ah
      WHERE ah.party_id = p.party_id
  )
ORDER BY p.party_id ASC;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM payment_event pe
    WHERE pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
      AND pe.payment_type = 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL'
  )
ORDER BY a.account_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT sg.security_id AS 担保协议编号, gc.guaranteed_amount AS 保证金额
FROM security_agreement sg
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON sg.security_id = gc.security_id
WHERE sg.status = 'EXPIRED'
ORDER BY gc.guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(current_maturity_on) < 0 THEN '已到期'
    WHEN julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(current_maturity_on) BETWEEN 0 AND 90 THEN '临期'
    ELSE '常态'
  END AS 档位,
  COUNT(*) AS 笔数
FROM loan_drawdown
GROUP BY 档位
ORDER BY CASE 档位 WHEN '常态' THEN 1 WHEN '临期' THEN 2 WHEN '已到期' THEN 3 END;

SELECT 
    cl.collateral_id AS 押品编号,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) AS 关联次数
FROM collateral_link cl
INNER JOIN security_agreement sa ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) > 1
ORDER BY 关联次数 DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_type AS 押品种类,
    ROUND(AVG(cv.valuation_amount), 2) AS 平均评估价值,
    COUNT(cv.valuation_id) AS 评估笔数
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
WHERE cv.appraiser_kind = 'INTERNAL'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_type
ORDER BY 平均评估价值 DESC;

WITH account_loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.repayment_account_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    WHERE ld.repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ld.repayment_account_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) >= 3
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.repayment_account_id,
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.disbursed_on,
        ld.disbursed_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ld.repayment_account_id 
            ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on ASC, ld.loan_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    INNER JOIN account_loan_counts alc ON ld.repayment_account_id = alc.repayment_account_id
)
SELECT 
    rl.repayment_account_id,
    rl.loan_id,
    rl.disbursed_on,
    rl.disbursed_amount,
    alc.loan_count
FROM ranked_loans rl
INNER JOIN account_loan_counts alc ON rl.repayment_account_id = alc.repayment_account_id
WHERE rl.rn <= 2
ORDER BY rl.repayment_account_id ASC, rl.disbursed_on ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ca.contract_amount AS 合同金额,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS 累计放款金额,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) - ca.contract_amount, 2) AS 超合同投放金额,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 放款笔数
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS 账户数量,
    ROUND(SUM(ABS(ABS(b.ledger_balance) - ABS(b.available_balance))), 2) AS 差额合计
FROM account a
JOIN account_balance_snapshot b ON a.account_id = b.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE b.ledger_balance > b.available_balance
  AND (b.ledger_balance - b.available_balance) > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 差额合计 DESC;

SELECT td.account_id, td.opening_principal, td.maturity_on, td.annual_interest_rate
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY td.maturity_on ASC;

SELECT 
    pc.card_id AS 卡片编号,
    ctc.name_zh AS 卡片种类,
    pc.issued_on AS 签发日期
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN card_type_catalog ctc ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
WHERE pc.card_type = 'DEBIT'
  AND pc.issued_on <= '2025-01-31'
  AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY pc.issued_on ASC, pc.card_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 累计受托支付金额,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'SELF_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 累计自主支付金额,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 0), 6) AS 受托支付占比
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ld.payment_mode IN ('ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT', 'SELF_PAYMENT')
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 受托支付占比 < 0.52
ORDER BY 受托支付占比 ASC, 机构名称 ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 单笔放款金额,
    contract_total.total_amount AS 合同内累计放款金额,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount * 100.0 / contract_total.total_amount, 2) AS 单笔占比
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN (
    SELECT agreement_id, SUM(disbursed_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM loan_drawdown
    GROUP BY agreement_id
) contract_total ON ld.agreement_id = contract_total.agreement_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_amount * 100.0 / contract_total.total_amount > 90
ORDER BY ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    ROUND(SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount), 2) AS 实际募集合计,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 计划募集合计,
    ROUND(SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 0), 6) AS 完成率
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN institution i ON wp.issuer_institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING ROUND(SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 0), 6) > 1.2
ORDER BY 完成率 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 借款人编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN ld.loan_id END) AS 逾期借据笔数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 全部借据笔数
FROM party p
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN ld.loan_id END) > 0
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN ld.loan_id END) < COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id)
ORDER BY 逾期借据笔数 DESC, 借款人编号 ASC;

SELECT 
    pi.instruction_id AS 支付指令编号,
    pi.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    p_borrower.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    p_payee.display_name AS 实际收款人名称,
    pi.instruction_amount AS 指令金额
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p_borrower ON ca.borrower_party_id = p_borrower.party_id
JOIN party p_payee ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = p_payee.party_id
WHERE pi.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id IS NOT NULL
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id != ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC, pi.instruction_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_on AS 放款日期,
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ca.signed_on AS 合同签署日期,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 放款金额
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < ca.signed_on
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    rs.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS 未结清期次数,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS 应还本金合计
FROM repayment_schedule rs
WHERE rs.loan_id NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT rs2.loan_id
    FROM repayment_schedule rs2
    WHERE rs2.status = 'PAID'
)
GROUP BY rs.loan_id
ORDER BY 应还本金合计 DESC, 借据编号 ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS 期末剩余本金,
    ROUND(lbs.overdue_principal, 2) AS 期末逾期本金
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > 10000000
ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_on AS 放款日期,
    ld.disbursement_account_id AS 发放账户编号,
    a.opened_on AS 账户开立日期
FROM loan_drawdown ld
LEFT JOIN account a ON ld.disbursement_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < a.opened_on
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on ASC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursement_account_id AS 发放账户编号,
    a.account_kind AS 账户类型,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 放款金额
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON ld.disbursement_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ca.security_type AS 担保方式,
    ca.contract_amount AS 合同金额,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE ca.security_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND ca.contract_amount > 8000000
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    ca.annual_interest_rate AS 合同年利率,
    ROUND(avg_same.avg_rate, 4) AS 同机构同类产品平均年利率,
    ROUND(ca.annual_interest_rate - avg_same.avg_rate, 4) AS 利率价差
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON (pr.source_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id OR pr.target_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id)
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        ca2.institution_id,
        ca2.product_family,
        AVG(ca2.annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement ca2
    GROUP BY ca2.institution_id, ca2.product_family
) avg_same ON ca.institution_id = avg_same.institution_id AND ca.product_family = avg_same.product_family
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
  AND ca.annual_interest_rate < avg_same.avg_rate
ORDER BY 利率价差 DESC;

SELECT
    pr.source_party_id AS 关联方甲方编号,
    pr.target_party_id AS 关联方乙方编号,
    rtc.relation_name_zh AS 关联关系名称
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc
    ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE pr.relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
  AND pr.source_party_id IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT ca.borrower_party_id
      FROM credit_agreement ca
      WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  )
  AND pr.target_party_id IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT ca.borrower_party_id
      FROM credit_agreement ca
      WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  )
ORDER BY rtc.relation_name_zh ASC, pr.relation_id ASC;

SELECT 
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id) AS member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS total_balance,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS balance_ratio
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id) >= 2
   AND SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital > 0.1
ORDER BY balance_ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    payer.display_name AS 付款方姓名,
    payee.display_name AS 收款方姓名,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 转账笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 转账金额合计
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account_holder ah_from ON pe.from_account_id = ah_from.account_id
JOIN party payer ON ah_from.party_id = payer.party_id
JOIN account_holder ah_to ON pe.to_account_id = ah_to.account_id
JOIN party payee ON ah_to.party_id = payee.party_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON (pr.source_party_id = payer.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = payee.party_id)
    OR (pr.source_party_id = payee.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = payer.party_id)
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE pe.payment_type = 'TRANSFER'
  AND rtc.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
GROUP BY payer.party_id, payee.party_id
ORDER BY 转账金额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
  AND wp.risk_level = 'R5'
  AND phs.lookthrough_depth > 1
ORDER BY wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT 
    phs.product_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT phs.asset_id) AS asset_count
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
WHERE phs.investment_path = 'NESTED_SPV'
GROUP BY phs.product_id
ORDER BY asset_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    lb.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ROUND(lb.principal_balance, 2) AS 账面本金余额,
    MAX(ds.principal_overdue_days) AS 最长逾期天数
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lb
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON lb.loan_id = ds.loan_id
WHERE lb.principal_balance > 90000000
  AND lb.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY lb.loan_id, lb.principal_balance
HAVING MAX(ds.principal_overdue_days) >= 200
ORDER BY 最长逾期天数 DESC, 借据编号 ASC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) AS involved_institution_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.borrower_party_id) AS member_count
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON egm.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) >= 2
ORDER BY involved_institution_count DESC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id AS 集团编号,
    eg.group_name AS 集团名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id) AS 逾期成员数,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 企业名称,
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT gc.guaranteed_amount), 0), 2) AS 对外担保合计,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT ca.contract_amount), 0), 2) AS 自身借款合计,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT gc.guaranteed_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT ca.contract_amount), 0), 2) AS 担保负债差额
FROM party p
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
  AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND (gc.guarantor_party_id IS NOT NULL OR ca.borrower_party_id IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT gc.guaranteed_amount), 0) > COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT ca.contract_amount), 0)
ORDER BY 担保负债差额 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 员工姓名,
    sm.staff_id AS 员工编号,
    COUNT(ca.agreement_id) AS 授信合同笔数
FROM staff_member sm
JOIN party p ON sm.person_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY p.display_name, sm.staff_id
ORDER BY 授信合同笔数 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 借款人姓名,
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 本金余额合计,
    pp.annual_income AS 年收入,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 倍数
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON a.account_id = ld.loan_account_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 2
ORDER BY 倍数 DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 员工姓名,
    so.operator_id AS 操作员编号,
    so.authority_level AS 权限级别,
    COUNT(ca.agreement_id) AS 自贷合同数
FROM staff_member sm
JOIN party p ON sm.person_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN service_operator so ON sm.staff_id = so.staff_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'STAFF'
  AND so.operator_kind = '信贷经办员'
GROUP BY p.display_name, so.operator_id, so.authority_level
ORDER BY 自贷合同数 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 员工姓名,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 放款金额,
    ld.disbursed_on AS 放款日期
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN account a ON ld.disbursement_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN party_type_catalog ptc ON p.party_type = ptc.party_type
WHERE ptc.party_type = 'STAFF'
  AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 借款人姓名,
    p.party_id AS 借款人客户编号,
    pp.annual_income AS 个人年收入,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due), 2) AS 应还本息总额,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 占年收入倍数
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
ORDER BY 占年收入倍数 DESC, p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT 
    lpc.product_name_zh AS 产品类别名称,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS 逾期期数,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_product_catalog lpc ON ca.product_family = lpc.product_family
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY lpc.product_name_zh
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 已过期笔数,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30' AND julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') <= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 九十天内到期笔数,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on > '2026-06-30' AND julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') > 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 九十天以上到期笔数
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE td.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20
ORDER BY 已过期笔数 DESC, 机构名称 ASC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id AS 营业单元编号,
    ou.unit_name AS 营业单元名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ah.account_id) AS 联合账户数量
FROM organization_unit ou
JOIN account a ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ah.party_id) > 1
ORDER BY 联合账户数量 DESC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id AS 营业单元编号,
    ou.unit_name AS 营业单元名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lbs.loan_id) AS 逾期笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ca.managing_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    r.loan_id AS 贷款编号,
    COUNT(r.installment_id) AS 逾期期数合计,
    ROUND(SUM(r.principal_due), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM repayment_schedule r
WHERE r.status = 'OVERDUE'
  AND r.due_date < '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY r.loan_id
HAVING SUM(r.principal_due) > 120000000
ORDER BY SUM(r.principal_due) DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT rs.installment_id) AS overdue_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.interest_due), 2) AS total_overdue_interest
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rs.installment_id) >= 30
ORDER BY overdue_installment_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 逾期贷款数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) >= 240
ORDER BY 逾期贷款数 DESC;

SELECT 
    rs.loan_id AS 贷款编号,
    rs.installment_no AS 期次序号,
    rs.principal_due AS 应还本金,
    rs.interest_due AS 应还利息
FROM repayment_schedule rs
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
  AND rs.paid_on IS NULL
  AND rs.principal_due > 90000000
ORDER BY rs.principal_due DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS total_credit_limit,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS total_disbursed_amount,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 4) AS disbursed_to_capital_ratio
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_facility cf ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON cf.facility_id = ca.facility_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > cs.net_capital
ORDER BY disbursed_to_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
    sa.secured_amount AS 设定担保金额,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS 保证人个数,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 保证金额合计
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
WHERE sa.security_type = 'GUARANTEE'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY 保证金额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    cf.facility_id AS 授信额度编号,
    cf.limit_amount AS 授信限额,
    sc.name_zh AS 额度状态名称
FROM credit_facility cf
LEFT JOIN status_catalog sc 
    ON sc.entity = 'credit_agreement' 
    AND sc.status_code = cf.status
WHERE cf.facility_type = 'REVOLVING'
ORDER BY cf.limit_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cf.facility_type,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS total_limit
FROM credit_facility cf
JOIN institution i ON cf.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY cf.institution_id, cf.facility_type
HAVING SUM(cf.limit_amount) > 2000000000
ORDER BY total_limit DESC;

SELECT facility_type AS 授信类型, COUNT(*) AS 记录数
FROM credit_facility
WHERE limit_amount > 300000000
GROUP BY facility_type
ORDER BY 记录数 DESC;

SELECT 
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh AS 支付方式中文名称,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 记录数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
LEFT JOIN payment_mode_catalog pmc ON ld.payment_mode = pmc.payment_mode
GROUP BY ld.payment_mode, pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY 记录数 DESC;

WITH ranked_products AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        actual_raise_amount,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY actual_raise_amount DESC) AS quartile_group
    FROM wealth_product
    WHERE status = 'ON_SALE'
),
filtered_products AS (
    SELECT 
        quartile_group,
        COUNT(*) AS product_count
    FROM ranked_products rp
    JOIN wealth_product wp ON rp.product_id = wp.product_id
    WHERE wp.minimum_holding_days > 0
    GROUP BY quartile_group
)
SELECT 
    quartile_group AS group_no,
    product_count
FROM filtered_products
WHERE product_count BETWEEN 31 AND 33
ORDER BY quartile_group ASC;

SELECT 
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS 循环授信限额合计,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 发放笔数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN credit_facility cf ON ca.facility_id = cf.facility_id
WHERE cf.facility_type = 'REVOLVING'
  AND ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
GROUP BY cf.facility_id
ORDER BY 循环授信限额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh AS 支付方式中文名称,
    COUNT(pi.instruction_id) AS 待执行指令数量
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN payment_mode_catalog pmc ON pi.payment_mode = pmc.payment_mode
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING'
GROUP BY pi.payment_mode, pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY 待执行指令数量 DESC;

SELECT 
    lpc.product_name_zh AS 融资工具中文名称,
    sc.name_zh AS 实体状态中文名称
FROM loan_product_catalog lpc
CROSS JOIN status_catalog sc
WHERE sc.entity = 'loan_drawdown'
ORDER BY lpc.product_name_zh, sc.name_zh;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id AS 营业单元编号,
    ou.unit_name AS 营业单元名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.staff_id) AS 信贷客户经理人数
FROM organization_unit ou
LEFT JOIN staff_assignment sa ON ou.org_unit_id = sa.org_unit_id
    AND sa.role_code = 'CREDIT_MANAGER'
    AND (sa.effective_to IS NULL OR sa.effective_to >= '2026-06-30')
    AND sa.effective_from <= '2026-06-30'
WHERE ou.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT sa.staff_id) DESC;

SELECT 
    d.loan_id,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    d.principal_overdue_days,
    d.overdue_principal
FROM delinquency_snapshot d
JOIN risk_classification rc ON d.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE d.principal_overdue_days > 30
  AND cg.grade_code = 'NORMAL'
  AND d.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY d.principal_overdue_days DESC, d.loan_id ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
WHERE ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ps.provision_stage = '2'
  AND ps.recognized_amount * 1.0 / ps.required_amount < 0.5
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    ROUND(SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount), 2) AS 拨备缺口合计金额
FROM provision_snapshot ps
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 拨备缺口合计金额 DESC, 机构名称 ASC;

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    a.account_subtype,
    abs.ledger_balance
FROM account a
LEFT JOIN account_holder ah 
    ON a.account_id = ah.account_id 
    AND ah.holder_role = 'SECONDARY'
    AND ah.effective_to IS NULL
JOIN account_balance_snapshot abs 
    ON a.account_id = abs.account_id
    AND abs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE a.status = 'DORMANT'
    AND a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
    AND ah.account_holder_id IS NULL
ORDER BY abs.ledger_balance DESC;

SELECT p.customer_segment AS 客户分层, COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id) AS 客户数量
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE pp.annual_income > 1000000
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY 客户数量 DESC, 客户分层 ASC;

SELECT 
    asset_category_primary AS 主要资产类别,
    COUNT(*) AS 资产数量
FROM managed_asset
WHERE industry_code IN (
    SELECT sector_code 
    FROM industry_sector 
    WHERE risk_category = 'RESTRICTED'
)
GROUP BY asset_category_primary
HAVING COUNT(*) < 33
ORDER BY 资产数量 DESC, 主要资产类别 ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    pp.annual_income AS 年收入,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS 授信额度合计,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 偿债比
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN credit_facility cf ON p.party_id = cf.obligor_party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY p.party_id, pp.annual_income
HAVING SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 3
ORDER BY 偿债比 DESC, p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT p.occupation_code, p.employment_sector, COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id) AS customer_count
FROM person_profile p
JOIN party pt ON p.party_id = pt.party_id
WHERE pt.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY p.occupation_code, p.employment_sector
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, p.occupation_code ASC, p.employment_sector ASC

SELECT pc.status AS 卡状态, COUNT(*) AS 发卡数量
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN card_type_catalog ctc ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
WHERE ctc.name_zh = '借记卡'
GROUP BY pc.status
ORDER BY 发卡数量 DESC, 卡状态 ASC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id AS 营业单元编号,
    ou.unit_name AS 营业单元名称,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 交易笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 金额合计
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN account a ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 金额合计 DESC, 营业单元名称 ASC;

SELECT p.payment_id, c.card_id, c.holder_party_id, p.business_date, p.amount
FROM payment_event p
JOIN payment_card c ON p.from_account_id = c.settlement_account_id
JOIN card_type_catalog ct ON c.card_type = ct.card_type
WHERE ct.name_zh = '贷记卡'
  AND p.is_cash = 1
ORDER BY p.amount DESC, p.payment_id ASC, c.card_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    pc.holder_party_id AS 持卡人编号,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 现金交易笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 金额合计
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN payment_event pe ON pc.settlement_account_id = pe.from_account_id
WHERE pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY pc.holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(pe.payment_id) > 5
ORDER BY 现金交易笔数 DESC, 金额合计 DESC;

SELECT holder_party_id AS 持卡人编号, COUNT(*) AS 发卡数量
FROM payment_card
GROUP BY holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 3
ORDER BY 发卡数量 DESC, 持卡人编号 ASC;

SELECT 
    c.name_zh AS 银行卡类型名称,
    COUNT(p.payment_id) AS 交易笔数,
    ROUND(AVG(p.amount), 2) AS 平均单笔金额
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN card_type_catalog c ON pc.card_type = c.card_type
JOIN account a ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN payment_event p ON p.from_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE pc.card_type IN ('CREDIT', 'DEBIT')
  AND p.payment_type = 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL'
  AND p.status = 'SETTLED'
GROUP BY pc.card_type, c.name_zh
ORDER BY 平均单笔金额 DESC, 银行卡类型名称 ASC;

SELECT 
    channel AS 交易渠道,
    COUNT(*) AS 交易数量,
    ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS 平均金额
FROM payment_event
WHERE status = 'SETTLED'
  AND is_cash = 0
GROUP BY channel
HAVING AVG(amount) > 11780000
ORDER BY AVG(amount) DESC, channel ASC;

SELECT t.account_id, t.maturity_on, a.status
FROM term_deposit t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.maturity_on < '2026-06-30'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY t.maturity_on DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    MAX(cv.valuation_amount) AS max_valuation_amount
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING COUNT(cv.valuation_id) >= 2
ORDER BY max_valuation_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id AS 押品编号,
    ca.asset_label AS 押品标识,
    COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) AS 押品被引用的次数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) AS 关联的不同担保合同数
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_link cl ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) >= 2
ORDER BY COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) DESC, ca.collateral_id ASC;

SELECT 
    gc.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ROUND(gc.guaranteed_amount, 2) AS 保证承诺金额,
    ROUND(ld.total_disbursed, 2) AS 该合同实际放款总金额
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON gc.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN (
    SELECT agreement_id, SUM(disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed
    FROM loan_drawdown
    GROUP BY agreement_id
) ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND gc.guaranteed_amount > ld.total_disbursed
ORDER BY gc.guaranteed_amount DESC, gc.guarantor_party_id ASC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ca.borrower_party_id AS 债务人编号,
    ca.contract_amount AS 授信合同金额,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0), 2) AS 担保覆盖合计,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount - COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0), 2) AS 保障缺口
FROM credit_agreement ca
LEFT JOIN secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.borrower_party_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING ca.contract_amount > COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0)
ORDER BY 保障缺口 DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    cg.grade_name_zh AS 五级分类名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 借据笔数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
WHERE cg.grade_code = 'SUBSTANDARD'
  AND ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
  AND rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY 借据笔数 DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.borrower_party_id AS 债务人编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS 贷款余额,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS 授信金额,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount, 2) AS 余额倍数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.principal_balance >= 4 * ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY 余额倍数 DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    COUNT(*) AS over_provisioned_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ps.recognized_amount - ps.required_amount), 2) AS over_provisioned_amount
FROM provision_snapshot ps
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ps.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE cg.is_nonperforming = 1
  AND ps.recognized_amount > ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh
HAVING SUM(ps.recognized_amount - ps.required_amount) > 0
ORDER BY over_provisioned_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC, cg.grade_name_zh ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id AS 抵押物编号,
    ca.asset_label AS 抵押物名称,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'INTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END), 2) AS 内部评估最高价值,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END), 2) AS 外部评估最高价值,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'INTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) - MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END), 2) AS 低估差额
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND cv.valuation_type IN ('INTERNAL', 'EXTERNAL')
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'INTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) IS NOT NULL
   AND MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) IS NOT NULL
   AND MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'INTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) > MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END)
ORDER BY 低估差额 DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id AS 抵质押物编号,
    ca.asset_label AS 资产名称,
    ROUND(latest_val.valuation_amount, 2) AS 最新评估价,
    ROUND(COALESCE(link_sum.total_pledged, 0), 2) AS 累计质押额,
    ROUND(COALESCE(link_sum.total_pledged, 0) - latest_val.valuation_amount, 2) AS 覆盖缺口
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        cv.collateral_id,
        cv.valuation_amount,
        cv.valued_on
    FROM collateral_valuation cv
    JOIN (
        SELECT collateral_id, MAX(valued_on) AS max_valued_on
        FROM collateral_valuation
        GROUP BY collateral_id
    ) latest ON cv.collateral_id = latest.collateral_id AND cv.valued_on = latest.max_valued_on
) latest_val ON ca.collateral_id = latest_val.collateral_id
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        cl.collateral_id,
        SUM(cl.pledged_amount) AS total_pledged
    FROM collateral_link cl
    WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
) link_sum ON ca.collateral_id = link_sum.collateral_id
WHERE (link_sum.total_pledged - latest_val.valuation_amount) > 0
ORDER BY 覆盖缺口 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ROUND(COALESCE(loan_sum.total_loan_amount, 0), 2) AS 自身借款金额合计,
    ROUND(COALESCE(guarantee_sum.total_guarantee_amount, 0), 2) AS 对外保证金额合计
FROM party p
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT ca.borrower_party_id, SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_loan_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
) loan_sum ON loan_sum.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT gc.guarantor_party_id, SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guarantee_amount
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
) guarantee_sum ON guarantee_sum.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, loan_sum.total_loan_amount, guarantee_sum.total_guarantee_amount
HAVING COALESCE(guarantee_sum.total_guarantee_amount, 0) > COALESCE(loan_sum.total_loan_amount, 0)
ORDER BY 对外保证金额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
    ROUND(sa.secured_amount, 2) AS 担保债权金额,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS 保证人数量,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 保证承诺金额合计
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) DESC;

SELECT 
    p.customer_segment AS 客户分群,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id) AS 客户数量
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN party_type_catalog ptc ON p.party_type = ptc.party_type
WHERE ptc.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND pp.is_public_official = 1
  AND pp.annual_income >= 300000
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY 客户数量 DESC, 客户分群 ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    egt.name_zh AS 中文敞口组类型名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS 成员去重数量
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN institution i ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_type_catalog egt ON eg.group_type = egt.group_type
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
GROUP BY i.institution_name, egt.name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 6
ORDER BY 成员去重数量 DESC;

SELECT 
    egm.party_id AS member_customer_id,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM exposure_group_member egm
JOIN party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY egm.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) >= 2
ORDER BY group_count DESC, member_customer_id ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 主体编号,
    p.display_name AS 主体名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_id) AS 关联关系条数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 借款合同笔数
FROM party p
LEFT JOIN party_relation pr 
    ON (pr.source_party_id = p.party_id OR pr.target_party_id = p.party_id)
    AND pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca 
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_id IN (
    SELECT source_party_id FROM party_relation WHERE relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
    UNION
    SELECT target_party_id FROM party_relation WHERE relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
)
AND p.party_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT borrower_party_id FROM credit_agreement)
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 关联关系条数 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS 所属集团数量
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr 
    ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id 
    OR pr.target_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc 
    ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
JOIN exposure_group_member egm 
    ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh = '影子股东'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 所属集团数量 DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    pr.relation_id,
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca1.agreement_id) AS source_agreement_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca2.agreement_id) AS target_agreement_count
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca1 ON pr.source_party_id = ca1.borrower_party_id
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca2 ON pr.target_party_id = ca2.borrower_party_id
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
GROUP BY pr.relation_id, pr.source_party_id, pr.target_party_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca1.agreement_id) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ca2.agreement_id) > 0
