ORDER BY (COUNT(DISTINCT ca1.agreement_id) + COUNT(DISTINCT ca2.agreement_id)) DESC;

SELECT c.collateral_id, c.asset_label, c.collateral_type
FROM collateral_asset c
WHERE c.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM collateral_link cl
    WHERE cl.collateral_id = c.collateral_id
      AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
  )
ORDER BY c.collateral_id ASC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ROUND(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 有效保证责任合计,
    ROUND(COALESCE(loan_exposure.self_loan_amount, 0), 2) AS 自身贷款金额,
    ROUND(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) - COALESCE(loan_exposure.self_loan_amount, 0), 2) AS 超额担保金额
FROM guarantor_commitment g
JOIN party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS self_loan_amount
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
) loan_exposure ON g.guarantor_party_id = loan_exposure.borrower_party_id
WHERE g.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY g.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name, loan_exposure.self_loan_amount
HAVING SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) > COALESCE(loan_exposure.self_loan_amount, 0)
ORDER BY 超额担保金额 DESC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    g.guaranteed_amount AS 保证金额,
    g.status AS 保证状态
FROM guarantor_commitment g
JOIN party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE g.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND g.guarantor_party_id IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT ca.borrower_party_id
      FROM loan_drawdown ld
      JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
      JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
      WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days > 0
  )
ORDER BY g.guaranteed_amount DESC, g.guarantor_party_id ASC;

WITH RECURSIVE nested_holdings AS (
    -- 直接持有的底层资产
    SELECT 
        ph.product_id,
        ph.asset_id,
        ph.investment_path,
        ph.lookthrough_depth,
        ph.intermediary_party_id,
        ma.obligor_party_id AS final_debtor_id,
        ma.asset_name
    FROM product_holding_snapshot ph
    JOIN managed_asset ma ON ph.asset_id = ma.asset_id
    WHERE ph.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- 递归穿透嵌套的SPV/通道
    SELECT 
        nh.product_id,
        ph.asset_id,
        ph.investment_path,
        ph.lookthrough_depth,
        ph.intermediary_party_id,
        ma.obligor_party_id AS final_debtor_id,
        ma.asset_name
    FROM product_holding_snapshot ph
    JOIN managed_asset ma ON ph.asset_id = ma.asset_id
    JOIN nested_holdings nh ON ph.intermediary_party_id = nh.final_debtor_id
    WHERE ph.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
-- 找出存在逾期借据的对公借款人
overdue_borrowers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(ds.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
    WHERE ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND ds.principal_overdue_days > 0
      AND ca.borrower_party_id IN (SELECT party_id FROM party WHERE party_type = 'CORPORATE')
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
)
SELECT 
    wp.product_name AS 产品名称,
    nh.asset_name AS 底层资产名称,
    nh.final_debtor_id AS 最终债务人编号,
    ob.total_overdue_principal AS 逾期本金合计
FROM nested_holdings nh
JOIN wealth_product wp ON nh.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN overdue_borrowers ob ON nh.final_debtor_id = ob.borrower_party_id
WHERE wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
  AND wp.issuer_institution_id = 'INST001'  -- 假设发行机构
ORDER BY wp.product_name ASC, ob.total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_type AS 担保方式,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.security_id) AS 担保合同笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(sa.secured_amount), 2) AS 被担保金额合计
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_type
ORDER BY 被担保金额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) AS collateral_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name, ca.contract_amount
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) > 0
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM institution i
JOIN exposure_group eg ON i.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id AND ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 5
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value), 2) AS total_reversal_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS reversal_count
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
WHERE phs.carrying_amount > phs.fair_value
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
HAVING SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) > 0
ORDER BY total_reversal_amount DESC, wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth,
    phs.carrying_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS overdue_principal_total
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = ma.issuer_party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth >= 3
  AND wp.issuer_institution_id = ca.institution_id
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY wp.product_name, ma.asset_name, phs.lookthrough_depth, phs.carrying_amount, phs.holding_id
ORDER BY phs.lookthrough_depth DESC, phs.holding_id ASC;

SELECT 
    cl.collateral_id,
    COUNT(*) AS first_lien_active_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_sixty_count
FROM collateral_link cl
WHERE cl.lien_priority = 1
  AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY over_sixty_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(fs.total_assets), 2) AS total_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(fs.total_liabilities), 2) AS total_liabilities,
    ROUND(SUM(fs.net_assets), 2) AS net_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(fs.annual_revenue), 2) AS annual_revenue
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY annual_revenue DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(fs.total_liabilities * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 4) AS debt_to_asset_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE fs.total_assets IS NOT NULL AND fs.total_assets > 0
  AND fs.total_liabilities IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY debt_to_asset_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.tier1_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 4) AS core_tier1_capital_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY core_tier1_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 6) AS net_capital_to_assets_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY net_capital_to_assets_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    ROUND(fs.annual_revenue, 2) AS 营业收入,
    ROUND(fs.annual_revenue * 1.0 / total_rev.total_revenue, 6) AS 占比
FROM financial_snapshot fs
JOIN institution i ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
JOIN (
    SELECT fs2.party_id, SUM(fs2.annual_revenue) AS total_revenue
    FROM financial_snapshot fs2
    WHERE fs2.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY fs2.party_id
) total_rev ON fs.party_id = total_rev.party_id
WHERE fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND fs.annual_revenue * 1.0 / total_rev.total_revenue > 0.15
ORDER BY 占比 DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ma.asset_id) AS inconsistent_asset_count
FROM managed_asset ma
JOIN institution i ON ma.originator_institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT asset_id, internal_rating, external_rating
    FROM managed_asset
    WHERE internal_rating IS NOT NULL
      AND external_rating IS NOT NULL
      AND internal_rating <> external_rating
) inc ON ma.asset_id = inc.asset_id
WHERE inc.asset_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY inconsistent_asset_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ma.valuation_method,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount), 2) AS total_carrying_amount
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
GROUP BY ma.valuation_method
ORDER BY total_carrying_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS 笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(td.opening_principal), 2) AS 本金合计
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 本金合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS deposit_count
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE td.annual_interest_rate > 3
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY deposit_count DESC;

SELECT 
    so.authority_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.operator_id) AS operator_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count
FROM service_operator so
JOIN staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE sm.employment_type = 'FIXED'
GROUP BY so.authority_level
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) >= 10
ORDER BY operator_count DESC, so.authority_level ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS 笔数
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN institution i ON ou.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30'
  AND td.maturity_on <= date('2026-06-30', '+30 days')
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 笔数 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount), 2) AS under_provision_total,
    ROUND(fs.net_assets, 2) AS net_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) * 1.0 / fs.net_assets, 6) AS under_provision_ratio
FROM provision_snapshot p
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON p.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE p.recognized_amount < p.required_amount
  AND p.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, fs.net_assets
HAVING SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) > 0
ORDER BY under_provision_ratio DESC, i.institution_id ASC;

SELECT cg.grade_name_zh AS 风险分类名称, COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 借据数量
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE cg.is_nonperforming = 1
  AND rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY cg.grade_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(ld.loan_id) BETWEEN 60 AND 105
ORDER BY 借据数量 DESC, 风险分类名称 ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS bad_loan_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days >= 90
  AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
  AND ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_id
HAVING ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal) * 1.0 / NULLIF(MAX(fs.annual_revenue), 0), 6) > 0.5
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 本金余额合计,
    ROUND(cs.risk_weighted_assets, 2) AS 风险加权资产,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 6) AS 贷款占风险加权资产百分比
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.risk_weighted_assets
ORDER BY 贷款占风险加权资产百分比 DESC, 机构名称 ASC;

SELECT 
    pi.payment_mode AS 结算方式,
    COUNT(pi.instruction_id) AS 待执行指令数量
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY pi.payment_mode
HAVING COUNT(pi.instruction_id) > 45
ORDER BY 待执行指令数量 DESC, 结算方式 ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(pr.record_id) AS abnormal_record_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pr.amount_value), 2) AS abnormal_amount,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(fs.total_assets, 2) AS total_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(pr.amount_value) * 100.0 / cs.net_capital, 4) AS abnormal_to_capital_pct
FROM prudential_metric_snapshot_v3 pr
JOIN institution i ON pr.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE pr.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.net_capital, fs.total_assets
HAVING COUNT(pr.record_id) >= 8
ORDER BY abnormal_to_capital_pct DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT rse.record_id) AS 监管报送逾期记录数,
    ROUND(AVG(rse.amount_value), 2) AS 台账平均金额,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 拨备不足借据数,
    ROUND(SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount), 2) AS 拨备缺口金额
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id AND ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
LEFT JOIN regulatory_submission_event_v3 rse ON i.institution_id = rse.institution_id 
    AND rse.completion_date IS NULL 
    AND rse.deadline_date < '2026-06-30'
WHERE ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rse.record_id) >= 25
ORDER BY 拨备缺口金额 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cf.facility_id) AS 授信额度批复总数,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN gce.exception_flag = 1 THEN gce.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 治理异常记录金额,
    ROUND(AVG(gce.ratio_value), 4) AS 平均观测比值
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_facility cf ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
LEFT JOIN governance_control_record_v3 gce ON i.institution_id = gce.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN gce.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 END) >= 5
ORDER BY 治理异常记录金额 DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.target_party_id) AS 关联目标主体数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_type) AS 关系种类数,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 非非关联方关系笔数
FROM related_transaction_record_v3 rtr
JOIN party p ON rtr.subject_id = p.party_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
LEFT JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE rtr.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 关联目标主体数 DESC, 关系种类数 DESC, 客户名称 ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS valid_card_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.holder_party_id) AS card_holder_count,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ore.exception_flag = 1 THEN ore.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS operational_risk_exception_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ore.record_id) AS operational_risk_valid_record_count
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN organization_unit ou ON i.institution_id = ou.institution_id
LEFT JOIN account a ON ou.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
LEFT JOIN payment_card pc ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN operational_risk_event_v3 ore ON i.institution_id = ore.institution_id AND ore.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ore.record_id) >= 43
ORDER BY operational_risk_exception_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wp.product_id) AS 在售产品数,
    ROUND(SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount), 2) AS 实际募集合计,
    COUNT(ppr.record_id) AS 产品行为记录数,
    ROUND(AVG(ppr.ratio_value), 4) AS 平均比值
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN wealth_product wp ON i.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id AND wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
LEFT JOIN product_conduct_event_v3 ppr ON i.institution_id = ppr.institution_id AND ppr.exception_flag = 1
WHERE i.institution_id IN (
    SELECT institution_id
    FROM product_conduct_event_v3
    WHERE exception_flag = 1
    GROUP BY institution_id
    HAVING COUNT(record_id) >= 2
)
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 实际募集合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ma.asset_id) AS asset_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ma.issued_amount), 2) AS total_issued_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cor.record_id) AS custody_active_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cor.exception_flag = 1 THEN cor.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS exception_amount
FROM managed_asset ma
JOIN institution i ON ma.originator_institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN custody_operation_event_v3 cor ON cor.subject_id = ma.asset_id AND cor.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE ma.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN cor.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 END) >= 2
ORDER BY total_issued_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;
